177770.name: daf-15
177770.summary: Predicted to enable protein kinase activator activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in nematode larval development and regulation of autophagosome assembly. Part of TORC1 complex. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; excretory cell; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; intestine; and pharyngeal muscle cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nicotine dependence. Orthologous to human RPTOR (regulatory associated protein of MTOR complex 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177775.name: idh-1
177775.summary: Predicted to enable isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Predicted to be involved in NADP+ metabolic process; isocitrate metabolic process; and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Predicted to be active in cytosol; mitochondrion; and peroxisome. Is expressed in several structures, including hypodermis; intestine; pharynx; rectal gland cell; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autoimmune disease; hematologic cancer (multiple); hepatocellular clear cell carcinoma; and high grade glioma (multiple). Orthologous to human IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP(+)) 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177778.name: hsp-12.6
177778.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein refolding and response to heat. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; muscle cell; sperm; and spermatid. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adult-onset myofibrillar myopathy 2A; cataract 16 multiple types; cataract 9 multiple types; dilated cardiomyopathy 1II; and infantile-onset myofibrillar myopathy-2B. Orthologous to human CRYAA (crystallin alpha A) and CRYAB (crystallin alpha B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177786.name: ndua-5
177786.summary: Predicted to be involved in respiratory electron transport chain. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; and pharynx. Orthologous to human NDUFA5 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit A5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

177787.name: elo-1
177787.summary: Predicted to enable fatty acid elongase activity. Involved in unsaturated fatty acid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; enteric muscle; intestine; pharynx; and rectal gland cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

177819.name: fat-4
177819.summary: Enables stearoyl-CoA 9-desaturase activity. Involved in unsaturated fatty acid biosynthetic process. Predicted to be active in membrane. Is expressed in intestine; nerve ring; and touch receptor neurons. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including FADS1 (fatty acid desaturase 1); FADS2 (fatty acid desaturase 2); and FADS3 (fatty acid desaturase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177858.name: C47E12.2
177858.summary: Predicted to enable ATP:ADP antiporter activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial ATP transmembrane transport and regulation of mitochondrial membrane permeability. Predicted to be located in membrane and mitochondrion. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial permeability transition pore complex. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177875.name: dis-3
177875.summary: Predicted to enable 3'-5'-RNA exonuclease activity and endonuclease activity. Predicted to be involved in nuclear mRNA surveillance of mRNA 3'-end processing and rRNA catabolic process. Predicted to be located in nucleolus and nucleoplasm. Predicted to be part of cytoplasmic exosome (RNase complex) and nuclear exosome (RNase complex). Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; excretory cell; hypodermis; nervous system; and reproductive system. Orthologous to human DIS3 (DIS3 exosome endoribonuclease and 3'-5' exoribonuclease). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177895.name: rack-1
177895.summary: Predicted to enable protein kinase C binding activity and ribosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including antifungal innate immune response; cytoskeleton-dependent cytokinesis; and motor neuron axon guidance. Located in several cellular components, including centrosome; growth cone; and kinetochore. Is expressed in anterior distal tip cell; neurons; and posterior distal tip cell. Orthologous to human RACK1 (receptor for activated C kinase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

177906.name: tkt-1
177906.summary: Predicted to enable thiamine pyrophosphate binding activity and transketolase activity. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in intestine; pharynx; reproductive system; and vulva. Orthologous to several human genes including TKT (transketolase) and TKTL2 (transketolase like 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177908.name: daf-14
177908.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; I-SMAD binding activity; and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; egg-laying behavior; and negative regulation of dauer larval development. Predicted to be part of heteromeric SMAD protein complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anal sphincter muscle; excretory duct cell; intestine; nerve ring; and phasmid sheath cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

177924.name: sir-2.1
177924.summary: Enables histone H4K deacetylase activity. Involved in dauer larval development; determination of adult lifespan; and intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to DNA damage. Located in chromosome, telomeric region; nucleus; and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including intestinal cell; neurons; retrovesicular ganglion; tail; and ventral nerve cord. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Huntington's disease. Orthologous to human SIRT1 (sirtuin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177929.name: spe-26
177929.summary: Predicted to enable ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. Predicted to be involved in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoskeleton. Predicted to be part of Cul3-RING ubiquitin ligase complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in spermatocyte and in male. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

177932.name: R10H10.7
177932.summary: Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human TTI1 (TELO2 interacting protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177936.name: ins-1
177936.summary: Predicted to enable hormone activity. Involved in several processes, including learning or memory; negative regulation of insulin receptor signaling pathway; and regulation of dauer entry. Located in several cellular components, including cytoplasmic vesicle; neuron projection; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in several structures, including distal tip cell; egg-laying apparatus; head muscle; neurons; and somatic nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

177943.name: tax-6
177943.summary: Enables calcium ion binding activity and calmodulin-dependent protein phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; male mating behavior; and olfactory learning. Located in several cellular components, including dendrite; neuronal cell body; and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; hypodermis; muscle cell; nervous system; and tail neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in aortic valve stenosis; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 91; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP3CB (protein phosphatase 3 catalytic subunit beta) and PPP3CC (protein phosphatase 3 catalytic subunit gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177958.name: fmo-2
177958.summary: Enables monooxygenase activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium and one-carbon metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in excretory gland cell; head; intestinal cell; intestine; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypertension; inherited metabolic disorder; and trimethylaminuria. Orthologous to several human genes including FMO2 (flavin containing dimethylaniline monoxygenase 2); FMO3 (flavin containing dimethylaniline monoxygenase 3); and FMO4 (flavin containing dimethylaniline monoxygenase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177968.name: T25B9.1
177968.description: Aminotransferase class I/classII large domain-containing protein
177968.otherdesignations: Aminotransferase class I/classII large domain-containing protein
177968.nomenclaturename: Aminotransferase class I/classII large domain-containing protein
177968.summary: Predicted to enable glycine C-acetyltransferase activity and pyridoxal phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in L-threonine catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human GCAT (glycine C-acetyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177985.name: rbr-2
177985.summary: Enables histone H3K4me/H3K4me2/H3K4me3 demethylase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and regulation of vulval development. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anchor cell and vulval precursor cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ankylosing spondylitis; breast cancer; descending colon cancer; high grade glioma; and intellectual disability (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including KDM5A (lysine demethylase 5A); KDM5B (lysine demethylase 5B); and KDM5C (lysine demethylase 5C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

177988.name: lsm-7
177988.summary: Predicted to contribute to RNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Predicted to be part of Lsm1-7-Pat1 complex; spliceosomal complex; and spliceosomal snRNP complex. Orthologous to human LSM7 (LSM7 homolog, U6 small nuclear RNA and mRNA degradation associated). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178001.name: lin-3
178001.summary: Enables receptor ligand activity. Involved in several processes, including egg-laying behavior; positive regulation of ovulation; and positive regulation of vulval development. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory canal; germ line; hermaphrodite gonad; rectal epithelial cell; and vulF. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178005.name: atg-7
178005.summary: Predicted to enable Atg12 activating enzyme activity and Atg8 activating enzyme activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer larval development; determination of adult lifespan; and positive regulation of autophagosome assembly. Predicted to be active in phagophore assembly site. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 31. Orthologous to human ATG7 (autophagy related 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178012.name: rps-5
178012.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity and rRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in ribosomal small subunit biogenesis and translation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleolus. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and small-subunit processome. Predicted to be active in ribosome. Orthologous to human RPS5 (ribosomal protein S5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178020.name: F01G4.6
178020.summary: Predicted to enable phosphate transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in phosphate ion transmembrane transport. Predicted to be located in membrane and mitochondrion. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; and pharynx. Orthologous to human SLC25A3 (solute carrier family 25 member 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178074.name: mep-1
178074.description: MOG interacting and ectopic P-granules protein 1
178074.otherdesignations: MOG interacting and ectopic P-granules protein 1
178074.nomenclaturename: MOG interacting and ectopic P-granules protein 1
178074.summary: Enables RNA binding activity; enzyme binding activity; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including gonad development; oocyte development; and vulval development. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including alimentary system; anal region; germ line; head; and nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178083.name: rps-11
178083.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS11 (ribosomal protein S11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178084.name: ragc-1
178084.summary: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity and GTPase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and regulation of autophagosome assembly. Predicted to be located in endomembrane system. Predicted to be part of Gtr1-Gtr2 GTPase complex. Predicted to be active in lysosome and nucleus. Is expressed in intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in renal hypomagnesemia 7, with or without dilated cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human RRAGC (Ras related GTP binding C) and RRAGD (Ras related GTP binding D). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178087.name: lys-6
178087.summary: Predicted to enable lysozyme activity. Predicted to be involved in innate immune response and signal transduction. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178089.name: mars-1
178089.summary: Predicted to enable methionine-tRNA ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in methionyl-tRNA aminoacylation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase multienzyme complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in body wall musculature. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2U; hereditary spastic paraplegia 70; and nonphotosensitive trichothiodystrophy 9. Orthologous to human MARS1 (methionyl-tRNA synthetase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178096.name: ndub-6
178096.summary: Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial electron transport, NADH to ubiquinone. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Orthologous to human NDUFB6 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit B6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178101.name: inx-8
178101.summary: Predicted to enable gap junction hemi-channel activity. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on germ cell proliferation. Is active in gap junction. Is expressed in several structures, including egg-laying apparatus; ganglia; gonad; pharyngeal muscle cell; and somatic gonad precursor. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in depressive disorder. Orthologous to human PANX1 (pannexin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178104.name: let-60
178104.summary: Enables GTP binding activity; phospholipase binding activity; and protein serine/threonine kinase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including learning or memory; positive regulation of receptor localization to synapse; and positive regulation of vulval development. Located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including gonad; head neurons; pharyngeal cell; vulval cell; and vulval precursor cell. Used to study RASopathy; cancer; and prostate cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Noonan syndrome (multiple); carcinoma (multiple); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (multiple); hematologic cancer (multiple); and malignant astrocytoma (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including HRAS (HRas proto-oncogene, GTPase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178113.name: par-5
178113.summary: Involved in several processes, including asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; determination of adult lifespan; and first cell cycle pseudocleavage. Located in cell cortex and nucleus. Is expressed in germ cell; gonad; head neurons; and oocyte. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 56; transitional cell carcinoma; and vulva squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including YWHAB (tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein beta) and YWHAZ (tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein zeta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178118.name: trpa-1
178118.description: Ion transport domain-containing protein;Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily A member 1 homolog
178118.otherdesignations: Ion transport domain-containing protein;Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily A member 1 homolog
178118.nomenclaturename: Ion transport domain-containing protein;Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily A member 1 homolog
178118.summary: Predicted to enable monoatomic ion channel activity. Predicted to be involved in monoatomic ion transmembrane transport. Located in neuronal cell body and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in several structures, including pharynx; rectal gland cell; sensory neurons; ventral nerve cord; and vulva. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial episodic pain syndrome 1. Orthologous to human TRPA1 (transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily A member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

178120.name: let-653
178120.summary: A structural constituent of cuticle. Involved in several processes, including embryonic ectodermal digestive tract morphogenesis; negative regulation of tube lumen cavitation; and positive regulation of vulval development. Located in apical plasma membrane; extracellular region; and supramolecular fiber. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory system; hypodermis; nervous system; rectal epithelial cell; and vulva. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178130.name: gdh-1
178130.summary: Predicted to enable L-glutamate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Predicted to be involved in L-glutamate catabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in head; intestine; pharynx; rectal gland cell; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia 6; hyperinsulinism; and hypoglycemia. Orthologous to several human genes including GLUD2 (glutamate dehydrogenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

178181.name: F19B6.1
178181.summary: Predicted to enable uridine kinase activity. Involved in embryo development. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in body wall musculature; hypodermis; pharynx; reproductive system; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to human UCKL1 (uridine-cytidine kinase 1 like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
